objects.text: Homesteads — follow the lane west to your own farm.
Whispering Fields — slimes near town, goblins and wolves to the south. Gnarlfang guards the far end.
The Mossy Crypt. Recommended level 10–16. Click the gate to pick Normal, Hard, Nightmare or Mythic. Your party shares one run.
Ember Hollow. Recommended level 26–32. Click the gate to pick Normal, Hard, Nightmare or Mythic. Your party shares one run.
Gnarlfang's Arena. Level 40 — bring friends. Master Aldric's grove lies beyond.
